Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: c_rehash script allows command injection
Vulnerabilities.Description: The c_rehash script allows command injection when processing crafted filenames. Local execution context and package usage should be validated before determining exposure.

Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: SM2 decryption buffer overflow
Vulnerabilities.Description: A buffer overflow can occur during SM2 decryption. Validate whether affected cryptographic code paths are reachable in the service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: zlib: integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow in zipOpenNewFileInZip4_6
Vulnerabilities.Description: MiniZip in zlib contains an integer overflow that may lead to a heap-based buffer overflow. No fixed Debian package was reported in this sample.

Vulnerabilities.Title: zlib: heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in inflate
Vulnerabilities.Description: A heap-based buffer over-read or overflow can occur in inflate in crafted inputs. Validate whether untrusted compressed input is accepted.

Vulnerabilities.Title: perl: CPAN module signature verification issue
Vulnerabilities.Description: A flaw in CPAN module signature verification can affect package integrity workflows. Validate whether runtime images include package-management paths.
